answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The nadir multiplier is published, charged in oasis, and ridge lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 4 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 3082 identities would post 883 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
